label: 4.4 cm Cuff Turn-Up
description: A 4.4cm turn-up cuff folds the hem back on itself to a moderate depth, adding weight that helps the trouser hang and break cleanly. Cuffs are slightly less formal than a plain hem and pair classically with pleated trousers, giving visual balance at the bottom of the leg. The 4.4cm depth is a restrained, traditional width.
